name: conclave
description: Multi-model AI collaboration for Claude Code - code reviews and second opinions

scripts.register: mkdir -p ~/.claude/commands ~/.claude/agents ~/.config/conclave && ln -sf $(pwd)/commands/review.md ~/.claude/commands/review.md && ln -sf $(pwd)/commands/consult.md ~/.claude/commands/consult.md && ln -sf $(pwd)/agents/review-investigator.md ~/.claude/agents/review-investigator.md && ln -sf $(pwd)/agents/multi-model-executor.md ~/.claude/agents/multi-model-executor.md && cp -n config/tools.example.json ~/.config/conclave/tools.json 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n config/prompt.example.md ~/.config/conclave/prompt.md 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n config/consult-prompt.example.md ~/.config/conclave/consult-prompt.md 2>/dev/null || true && echo '⊛ conclave registered'
scripts.unregister: rm -f ~/.claude/commands/review.md ~/.claude/commands/consult.md ~/.claude/agents/review-investigator.md && echo '⊛ conclave unregistered (config preserved at ~/.config/conclave)'
